requirement: Tamper-proof audit trail of every decision and action
clause_text: Paraphrase: audit logs of security-relevant actions must be kept so that they cannot be altered. Check against the primary text before quoting.

requirement: Report a cyber incident to CERT-In within 6 hours of detection
clause_text: Paraphrase: a cyber incident must be reported to CERT-In within 6 hours. The clock starts at detection. Check against the primary text before quoting.

requirement: Detailed personal data breach report within 72 hours (readiness)
source: DPDP Rules, Rule 7 (in force from 13 May 2027)
clause_text: Paraphrase: after a personal data breach, a detailed report is due within 72 hours. Shown as DPDP-aligned readiness, because the rule takes effect on 13 May 2027.

requirement: The insurer polices agent and POSP access, which sits outside the IRDAI cyber guideline scope
clause_text: Paraphrase: agents and POSPs are outside the guideline's scope, so the insurer has to supervise their access itself.

requirement: Agents access only policyholders in their own portfolio
clause_text: Access to a policyholder outside the agent's portfolio needs a transfer, servicing assignment or approval that names the agent.

requirement: Terminated or suspended identities cannot access data
clause_text: Any access by a terminated or suspended login scores at least 60 and is never auto-resolved.

requirement: Bulk exports are detected and reviewed
clause_text: An export of 200 or more rows, or any export of the most sensitive tier, raises a signal.

requirement: A human approves containment before it runs
clause_text: Playbooks run only after an analyst approves them with a reason of at least 20 characters.

requirement: Customer names are tokenised before AI processing
clause_text: Names become PH_### tokens before the AI sees them, and names are scrubbed from the AI's output. Revealing names is audited.
